learning_objective: 🎯 Explore the world of travel! Learn how the tourism and hospitality industries operate, and the skills needed to be a great tour guide.

main_concepts.simple_explanation: Tourism is the activity of people traveling to and staying in places outside their usual environment for leisure, business, or medical purposes.
This sector takes care of tourists. It involves providing comfortable accommodation (hotels, resorts), food and beverage services (restaurants), and a welcoming environment.
People travel for different reasons: Eco-tourism (enjoying nature), Cultural/Heritage tourism (visiting historical monuments), Medical tourism (traveling for surgery), and Adventure tourism.
A tour guide shows tourists around, explains the history and culture of the destination, ensures their safety, and makes the trip enjoyable. They must have excellent communication skills.
An itinerary is a detailed schedule of a trip. It includes flight timings, hotel check-ins, places to visit each day, and time allotted for meals and rest.

fun_activity.title: 🗓️ Plan a Dream Trip
fun_activity.instructions: Imagine you are a tour guide taking your family to a hill station. Write down a 1-day 'Itinerary' (Schedule). E.g., 8:00 AM - Breakfast, 9:00 AM - Visit the waterfall, 1:00 PM - Lunch.

exam_tips: 📌 Distinguish between Tourism (the travel part) and Hospitality (the staying and eating part).
📌 A good tour guide must know multiple languages, local history, and possess problem-solving skills.
📌 Remember the Indian philosophy of 'Atithi Devo Bhava' (The guest is equivalent to God) which guides this industry.
quick_recap: ⭐ Tourism is a massive generator of jobs and foreign exchange for a country's economy.
⭐ An itinerary helps manage time and budget effectively during a trip.
⭐ Eco-tourism focuses on responsible travel that does not harm the natural environment.
